summary: We’re opening early access for reviewers and program committee members, including new tools for reviewing submissions and leaving structured feedback.

sections.heading: Early access
sections.content:
## Reviewer early access is open

We’re inviting a small group of reviewers and program committee members to try the reviewing workflow.

Early access helps us validate:

- assignment visibility and filtering
- review submission UX
- feedback structure and clarity
- edge cases (withdrawals, revisions, conflicts)

If you enjoy improving processes, your feedback will have real impact.

sections.heading: What reviewers can do
sections.content:
### Reviewer tools included

- view assigned items
- leave structured comments
- track review status
- communicate clarifications via notes

We’re intentionally keeping the workflow minimal, so we can make it excellent before adding more.

sections.heading: How to join
sections.content:
## Getting access

To join early access:

- ensure your account email matches your reviewer invitation
- complete your profile (name + affiliation)
- follow the onboarding message you received

> If you believe you should have access but don’t, contact support with your email address.
